topic.reason: הנושא לא היה בשימוש (בהיסטוריה ריקה) והוא נותן את הפתיחים הקולניים והאמיתיים ביותר: משפט ש״כולנו אומרים״ (״תגיד סליחה״) ומחקר שמראה שסליחה בכפייה נתפסת כפחות יעילה. הוא גם מתאים לסיפור אישי, כי לילד קל יותר להבין סליחה כשהוא גיבור בסיפור. אין תאריך בלוח השנה שקשור למחר ולא בדקתי לוח שנה, ולכן לא נאמרת עובדה עונתית בחבילה. בקטלוג יש ספר לגילאי 4 עד 8 על נימוסים ואחריות (בדקתי היום באתר), רק לשימוש פנימי בקישור שבתגובות.

sources.title: Communication Skills Start at Home
sources.publisher: American Academy of Pediatrics, HealthyChildren.org (adapted from HealthyChildren Magazine, Winter 2022; updated 16 Mar 2023)
sources.quote: We often teach children to say "I'm sorry" without teaching them to acknowledge the issue. ... Instead, try "I am sorry I yelled at you. Mommy felt frustrated with the mess." ... Model full apologies ("I am sorry for...").
sources.supports: Children are often taught to say sorry without naming what happened; a full apology names the specific wrong; parents can model full apologies.

sources.title: How to Help Your Child Develop Empathy
sources.quote: We often insist that our toddlers say "I'm sorry" as a way for them to take responsibility for their actions. ... it doesn't necessarily help toddlers learn empathy. ... help children focus on the other person's feelings. ... Developing empathy takes time. ... Kayla is feeling sad because you took her toy car. ... Read stories about feelings.
sources.supports: Insisting on 'sorry' does not necessarily build empathy in toddlers; help children focus on the other person's feelings by naming them; empathy takes time; reading stories about feelings is recommended. Written for toddlers; we apply it to ages 3 to 5 as an analogy.

sources.title: Toddlers and Challenging Behavior: Why They Do It and How to Respond
sources.quote: Toddlers who are asked to say “sorry” without fully understanding what they’ve done wrong, do not learn from their actions. ... It helps when parents model how to apologize and take responsibility for their actions too.
sources.supports: Asking a toddler to say sorry without understanding what they did does not teach from the action; parents modelling apologies helps. Written for toddlers; applied to ages 3 to 5 as an analogy.

sources.title: Forcing kids to say 'I'm sorry' doesn't fool anybody
sources.publisher: Futurity, reporting a University of Michigan study (Craig Smith et al., Merrill-Palmer Quarterly, children aged 4 to 9), 30 Nov 2018
sources.quote: Coercing your child to apologize is going to backfire. ... But the coerced apologies weren't seen as effective, especially by the 7-to-9-year-olds, Smith says. ... "When your child is calm, help them see how the other person is feeling, and why," Smith says. "Research shows that even preschoolers value it when a wrongdoer makes amends with action."
sources.supports: In a study of children, coerced apologies were seen as less effective (especially by ages 7 to 9); the researcher advises waiting until the child is calm and helping them see how the other person feels; preschoolers value amends made with action. The study measured children's judgments, not long-term outcomes.

sources.title: Taming Tempers
sources.publisher: Nemours KidsHealth (reviewed June 2022, Margaux J. Barnes, PhD)
sources.quote: Once your child calms down, ask what got them so upset. ... But don't push too hard for your child to talk right then. ... They may need some time to reflect before being ready to talk.
sources.supports: After an outburst wait until the child calms down before talking; they may need time to reflect before being ready to talk. The page is about tempers, applied here to the moment after a conflict.

claims.wording_he: אני אומר סליחה מהר כדי לחזור לשחק
claims.supports: Imagined child voice, one possibility for this one child; the Michigan study found children read coerced apologies as less effective (children aged 4 to 9).

claims.wording_he: כשאני לא מבין מה קרה לצד השני המילה הזאת לא מלמדת אותי כלום
claims.supports: Zero To Three: toddlers asked to say sorry without fully understanding what they did wrong do not learn from their actions; AAP: children are often taught to say sorry without acknowledging the issue. Toddler source, applied to age 4 as an analogy, written in the child's voice.

claims.wording_he: עשר שניות בלי מילים עד שהנשימה שלי נרגעת
claims.supports: The ten seconds are our practical suggestion; it rests on KidsHealth (once the child calms down, ask what upset them; they may need time) and the Michigan researcher (help them see how the other feels when the child is calm).

claims.wording_he: תסבירו לי מה קרה: אלון בוכה כי המגדל שלו נפל
claims.supports: AAP: teach children to acknowledge the issue, not only to say sorry; Zero To Three: name the other child's feeling and the reason (Kayla is feeling sad because you took her toy car). The sentence itself is our example.

claims.wording_he: תשאלו מה הוא הרגיש: איך אלון הרגיש כשהפלת לו את המגדל
claims.supports: Zero To Three: help children focus on the other person's feelings; the Michigan researcher: help them see how the other person is feeling, and why. The question wording is ours.

claims.wording_he: תנו לי לתקן בעצמי: לבנות לו מגדל חדש זו סליחה שאני מבין
claims.supports: The Michigan researcher: even preschoolers value it when a wrongdoer makes amends with action. The new tower is our example.

claims.wording_he: תתנצלו גם אתם כשצריך: סליחה שצעקתי עליך
claims.supports: AAP: model full apologies (I am sorry I yelled at you); Zero To Three: it helps when parents model how to apologize and take responsibility. The sentence follows the AAP example.

claims.wording_he: אני לא בטוח שאבין מהפעם הראשונה ואני לומד לאט
claims.supports: Imagined child voice, a possibility and not a promise; rests on Zero To Three: developing empathy takes time.

claims.wording_he: אפשר לעזור לו גם בסיפור אישי
claims.supports: Zero To Three recommends reading stories about feelings. That the story is personalised, with the child as the hero, is our wording.

claims.wording_he: ספר שבו הילד שלכם הוא הגיבור
claims.supports: The child's name is in the text and he stars in every illustration (live site FAQ, 13 Oct 2026). No brand or title on the slide.

option.conversion_rationale: מספר וערך על הכריכה (6 דברים) והילד מסתכל ישר לעדשה. שקופית 2 מסבירה למה המילה לבד לא מלמדת, ושקופיות 3 עד 8 נותנות דבר אחד בכל פעם, כך שאפשר להתחיל כבר מחר. שקופית 9 היא סיכום לשמירה, ושקופית 10 היא המשך טבעי להבנה של המילה.
